reviews.text:
I loveeeeeee this grooming place , the staff is sooo friendly … Layla my dog is old and they treat her so kind and with so much love !
This is the BEST place by far !
I highly recommend it !

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I cannot say enough amazing things about Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming! They do an INCREDIBLE job every single time with both of my babies, Luna, my Cavapoo, and Gizmo, my Pekingese. 🐾💗

They always come home looking absolutely adorable, perfectly groomed, soft, fluffy, and smelling amazing! You can tell the groomers genuinely care about the dogs and take their time making sure they look and feel their best.

With two completely different breeds and coats, I really appreciate having groomers I can trust to know exactly what each of them needs. Luna and Gizmo always look like a million bucks when I pick them up! ✨

If you’re looking for a groomer who treats your fur babies like their own AND does beautiful work, Woof Gang is the place. We absolutely LOVE them and wouldn’t go anywhere else! 🐶💕🐶

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ HIGHLY recommend!

Leslie is absolutely wonderful with my Siberian Husky, Kairos! She is warm, kind, and incredibly professional. Kairos adores her and is so comfortable with her that he sometimes falls asleep during his bath! 🥰🫣

She treats him with so much love and care, as if he were her own. I especially appreciate how thorough she is with drying him—Huskies can be difficult to get completely dry, but Leslie always makes sure he leaves completely dry and comfortable. We truly love her! 🐾❤️

Our pup Maru is a Shiba Inu and she is fully blind. Maru has been to Woof gang multiple times and always come back looking good. Especially during her shedding seasons. Most recently, Angela took really good care of Maru. She came back looking very very fresh and clean! Highlight recommend Angela for your pups with special needs.
My dog looks great after visiting Woof Gang. Brenda does an amazing job!!!
It is very nice and puntual. She treats Decker very nice and gently.
Brenda was fantastic! I was surprised to find Quincy relaxed at pickup time.  Usually he’s super stressed from a grooming.  Very happy with the experience.

My dog loves to go the Woofgang Bakery at Tanglewood. When I arrive for his bath appointment, Leslie is there to walk him in. She and the entire staff for sure take very good care of him.
By the way, Hulk loves their cookies too. I always buy some to have at my place. I give to him as a treat.
My sincere thank you to Woofgang Bakery. I strongly recommend everything in this place.
Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star rating!!!
Leslie was wonderful! She did a great job on our fur baby. This is our go to spot to get a fur baby looking cute.
Excellent service always! I take my pup here to get his nails trimmed. They go the extra mile to make sure he is comfortable.
Love taking my corgi here for her bath and groom! They are always so sweet and do an excellent job.
Woof Gang always does a good job! 10 out of 10 stars 🌟
Thank you for your generous 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your feedback and are glad to hear that you had a positive experience with us!

I had such a wonderful experience with Diamond! She did an amazing job grooming my little Bella. ❤️ Bella looks absolutely adorable, clean, and beautifully groomed. You can tell Diamond truly cares about the dogs and takes her time to make sure they look and feel their best.
Gabby does wonderful with Nacho’s bath and is so sweet with him!
Woof Gang is the place for grooming my dog!  Easy to schedule day and time.  Brenda cares about my very anxious dog, and helps him  relax. Always a good cut; she listens to what I want to do.
WoofGang is the best Groomer in the Memorial Tanglewood area.  Make sure to book with Diamond or Angel. They will take great care of your furbabies.
Diamond did a great job with Abbey’s grooming.  Perfect cut with attention to eyes and face.  Will definitely ask for Diamond again!
Angel does a terrific job in grooming LuLu.  We love bringing her to Woof Gang and have always received excellent customer care.
Angel did a great job with bunny! We love woof gang!
Excellent care for my Cavalier Spaniel. He looks great after grooming with meticulous detail. I will come back here!
They always do the best job!! 10/10 every time!!
Brenda is our go to groomer!  She listens, and will tweak when needed to keep Boudreaux looking so handsome!
Great job! Blended my dogs tail perfectly.

I had such a great experience at Woof Gang! The service was fast, professional, and welcoming from start to finish. Everyone was so kind and friendly, and you can truly feel the genuine care they have for the pets they work with. 🐾❤️Diamond was an absolutely wonderful groomer! She was patient, caring, and did an amazing job. I really appreciated how gentle and attentive she was, and my pup looked so beautiful and well taken care of afterward. You can tell Diamond genuinely has a kind heart and loves what she does.The entire environment was warm, friendly, and comfortable, which made the experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend Woof Gang and especially Diamond to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares! 10/10 experience! 🐶 Thank you!
This is the cutest most amazing place to take your babies!!!

Love this place! They treat you and your pet like family 🤗 Their work is amazing and very thorough
I appreciate all they’ve done for my fur babies and I!
Plus they have a bunch for cute treats and toys!
Amazing groomer they left rocky great Alicia was very helpful
The groomers did a very good job. Alisha was very helpful and helped me find treats for my dog

Pluto had a wonderful grooming session here. The ladies took very good care of him per usual! Special shoutout to Alicia & Gabby for their exceptional customer service and for always making this stressful experience for my dog, a pleasant one! Frenchies require special care and they always go the extra mile!
These ladies are so attentive and sweet!

I can’t say enough good things about this grooming salon! My dog typically doesn’t do the best with grooming or being in salons, and it’s something we’ve been working on overcoming with him. He had an appointment today, and the girls who took care of him were absolutely amazing. They were so gentle, patient, and understanding with him, which made me feel so comfortable knowing he was in good hands.

Not only did they take such great care of him, but he looks SO handsome! You can truly tell they care about the dogs they work with and take the time to make them feel comfortable. I’m so happy with his experience today and will definitely be coming back. 100% recommend! 🤍🐾
Diamond did such a good job with my anxious dog. she took her time and the hair cut was awesome! My dog doesn’t like his nails trimmed but she was able to get it done!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support! 🐾 …
Wolf gang always does a great job taking care of our fur babies. They have another summer cut and look so cute

Woofgang Tanglewood is the only place I will take my dog to get groomed. They are so friendly and are very understanding that my dog is a bit neurotic and sometimes needs extra accommodations, like a happy hoodie. Gabby always does a beautiful job on Brinley’s mini-groom and the receptionist is always so welcoming. Thank you guys!!
I take my dog here every 7 weeks and she is treated like a queen. They are so kind and take great care of my girl. She always comes home smelling great and looking well groomed

They always do a great job grooming my
Pup!
WE LUV BRINGING KOBE TO SEE MS. ANGEL!  The staff overall is VERY pleasant and welcoming. Soooo many appealing treats and trinkets for any pet. I wouldn’t dare go anywhere else! Kobe LOVES the place🥰
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! Your feedback means a lot to us!
I’ve liked and trusted them to groom my little corgi girl since she was a puppy. She’s always happy and well taken care of when she is done.
Thank you for your wonderful 5-star rating! We truly value your loyalty!!
Love the groomers at Woof Gang! Angel and Diamond make our pup look fabulous!
Thank you for your wonderful rating! We look forward to your next visit!
Diamond is a great groomer! She cut my deuce just right. Very professional set of groomers here at woof gang.

Wood Gang Bakery always does an amazing job grooming our dog, Georgia! She comes home looking beautiful, happy, and well cared for every time. The staff is friendly, professional, and clearly loves the dogs they work with. Highly recommend!
I love bringing my pup to woof gang. They are always friendly and treat my dog with care. Angel the groomer and her team always do my dog full groom and never disappoint.

Today was our first time trying Woof Gang and everything went perfectly. Sammy is a difficult dog so we weren’t sure they would be able to handle him. From the moment we walked in, the staff put us at ease and made the entire experience seamless. Gabby was amazing! She did a fantastic job getting rid of all the mats and left Sammy looking smooth.  I think we found Sammy’s new groomer and he will definitely be back!

We’ve trusted our dog to this grooming team multiple times, and they consistently do an excellent job. They are friendly, professional, and genuinely attentive to our dog’s comfort and well-being. Our dog always comes home looking great, clean, and well cared for, and it’s clear they take pride in their work. We appreciate the quality of service and would confidently recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable, caring groomer.
We LOVE Woof Gang on San Felipe! Diamond is amazing and everyone was so thoughtful and careful for our puppy’s first grooming experience. Our little girl loved her “spa day”! 5 tail wags!❤️
my dog hates his nails being clipped and they did it with ease. very happy!
I love the Woofgang team, they are so sweet and loving my 2 dogs. They do a great job on grooming and are all so friendly !
Such a great experience, we are definitely coming back!!
Took my cat to get groomed and they did a great job! I will be coming back

Thank you for taking such great care of Nala and Simba over the past three years! I have trusted only your team with their grooming, and every visit has been a wonderful experience. Their haircuts always look amazing, and they come home clean, happy, and smelling great.

A special thank you to Leslie for her kindness, professionalism, and outstanding customer service. She always makes us feel welcome and truly cares about my dogs.

I highly recommend this grooming salon to anyone looking for a place that genuinely loves and cares for pets. Thank you for everything!
My Sophie loved her spa day with Super cute store with a lot of great products too!
Thank you so much for this review! We adore Ms Pepper and appreciate your support!! :)
They were so great with my 2 pups! They made sure to double-check for any injuries, and they went over exactly how I want my dogs to look after getting groomed. Will definitely be back!

We had an awful experience. They groomed my maltipoo  and made him multiples scratches in his belly. I complain and theanager was never to be found, never returned my calls. I went there in person and the front desk lady told me to apply coconut oil, really? Are you a vet? So rude and so careless. I won't recommend it! Overpriced and poor costumer service.

We've been taking our Husky to Woof Gang Grooming regularly, and every visit has been an outstanding experience. Their customer service is exceptional, and the grooming expertise is truly top-notch. It's obvious that the staff genuinely cares about the dogs they work with.

A special shout-out to Gabby! She is absolutely amazing with our dogs and always greets us with such a warm, friendly welcome. She takes the time to make sure our Husky is comfortable and looking his absolute best every single visit.

If you're looking for a groomer you can trust, I highly recommend Woof Gang Grooming. And if you can, be sure to request Gabby—you and your pup will be in excellent hands!

I couldn’t be happier with the grooming service! From the moment we walked in, everyone was kind, welcoming, and clearly cared about my dog. The groomer, Gabby, took the time to listen to exactly what I wanted and made sure my pup was comfortable throughout the appointment.
They do the best job here! I’ll always bring my babies here with peace of mind
Service is always great. Leslie is super helpful up front and Brenda really nice with the furballs
We LOVE it here! We’ve been coming for years now! It’s always a great time for her and the staff is amazing 🤩
Lovely experience! Groomer and front desk were all very sweet and my furbaby was very relaxed upon pick up which is a huge green flag for me !
